title: First steps
instructions: Each command ends with a ; and they run in order, from top to bottom. Drive to the circled 1 with forward(), then back up onto the X with backward().
note: Anything after // is a comment. The rover skips it; it's a note for people.
hint: The circle is 4 cells ahead, and the X is 2 cells back from there. Put backward(2); on its own line under forward(). Spelling and capital letters matter, so Forward(4) won't work.
